class.name: IfcStructuralSurfaceConnection
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Instances of IfcStructuralSurfaceConnection describe face 'nodes', i.e. faces where two or more surface members are joined, or face supports. Face surfaces may be planar or curved. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: Use definitions added. Coordinate Systems : See definitions at IfcStructuralItem . The local coordinate system is established by the reference surface
